title: WebContentsView turns opaque after being reattached to the same parent
body:
### Electron Version

42.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS 14.7

### Expected Behavior

The reattached view keeps the same transparent appearance.

### Actual Behavior

After removing and reattaching the view, its background is solid black. Here is the constructor from the app:

```js
const view = new WebContentsView({
  webPreferences: {
    sandbox: true,
    contextIsolation: true
  }
});
```

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

The actual parent-window setup, view attachment code and HTML are not included.
